_comment: The shipped version, and the oldest one still allowed to play. ONE source of truth: tools/build-web.js copies this into dist/ so GitHub Pages serves it at /lumen/release.json, .github/workflows/mobile.yml reads `version` from it to stamp the binaries, and js/update.js fetches it on launch to decide whether an installed app is out of date. Bump `version`+`build` when a release ships. Move `minBuild` ONLY to force an update -- everyone below it is hard-blocked with no way to dismiss, so it is for a broken or unsafe build, not for a content drop.
